neighbours.label: bond / loan repayment context at the point where 'principal' or 'maturity' is the next word ("pay interest and → principal", "date of → maturity"); a prediction pole, it fires on the token before
fire: The issuer promises to pay bondholders interest and principal on schedule.
Investors receive the face value of the note at the date of maturity.
Each mortgage payment is split between interest and principal by the lender.
A zero-coupon bond pays nothing until its maturity, when the holder is repaid.
The company defaulted and failed to repay the principal on its debentures.
Holders of the ten-year bond get back the principal when the bond matures.
Early in the loan most of the instalment covers interest rather than principal.
The debenture carries a fixed coupon and a stated date of maturity in 2031.
quiet: The company promises to pay shareholders a dividend on schedule.
Investors receive a statement of their holdings at the end of the quarter.
Each grocery bill is split between food and household goods by the app.
A growth stock pays nothing to its owners while profits are reinvested.
The company struggled and failed to meet the sales targets for its stores.
Holders of the airline's shares get a vote when the board meets.
Early in the year most of the budget covers salaries rather than equipment.
The insurance policy carries a fixed premium and a stated deductible for 2031.

notes: Output direction promotes ' principal', ' maturity', ' face', ' matures'. Probes: 'repay the interest and' 0.67, 'redeemed at its face value on the date of' 0.90, 'reduces the' 0.41; non-debt 'and' 0.00; but 'The bond pays a coupon' 0.37, so bond context alone gives some activation. Near misses are other finance topics without debt repayment.
